info.title: TheMoak ERP API
info.description: Connect to TheMoak ERP system to query financial data, accounts, orders, and record transactions.

get.description: Fetch financial summaries, accounts, transactions, orders, a sales report, settlements, loans, search, stock across warehouses, per-product sales, suppliers or purchase orders. orders and transactions reach the whole history a page at a time (from, to, limit, offset; the answer has total and nextOffset). salesReport adds up every sale of a period, or of the whole history, on the server.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The data to fetch: summary | accounts | transactions | orders | salesReport | settlements | loans | search | inventory | productSales | suppliers | purchaseOrders

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page: transactions default 50 (max 500), orders default 30 (max 200)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: transactions/orders: rows to skip; pass the previous answer's nextOffset for the next page (null there means no more)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: transactions/orders/salesReport: first Gregorian day, YYYY-MM-DD, Tehran time, included. A Jalali date is refused.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: transactions/orders/salesReport: last Gregorian day, YYYY-MM-DD, Tehran time, included whole

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter transactions by type: INCOME | EXPENSE | TRANSFER | ADJUSTMENT

parameters.name: low
parameters.description: Low-stock threshold for action=inventory&filter=low, counted on `available`

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Sales window in days when action=productSales (max 730)

parameters.name: supplier
parameters.description: action=purchaseOrders: a supplier's id, or part of its name

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: action=purchaseOrders: only orders in this status

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: action=purchaseOrders: only orders carrying this tag, e.g. PI:2026-031

post.summary: Write to ERP (record transactions, suppliers, products, purchase orders)
post.description: Record a deposit, expense/payment, or internal transfer between accounts. Send a fresh requestId with each entry and the same one when retrying it: an entry is booked once per requestId. Also: a supplier, a product, or a purchase order recorded in the supplier's currency with no Toman figure (its Toman value is the rate paid, at payment). A tag starting with PI: books one order per PI. payPurchaseOrder records a payment on a purchase order in the currency actually paid, from an account in any currency (accountAmount = amount / accountRate; Toman value = accountAmount x tomanRate); the order's balance is kept in the order's currency, and when it reaches 0 the order is PAID and its Toman figures are set from what was paid. addPurchaseOrderCost adds a cost to a purchase order in the order's currency. Both take the full key, or a personal key whose role may (finance.manage to pay, cost.edit to add a cost).

200.description: Transaction recorded, or already recorded under this requestId (duplicate: true, nothing new written)

400.description: Bad request — missing fields, no exchange rate for the currency, or the same source and destination

422.description: Refused — amount not above 0, unknown currency, a transfer currency that is not the accounts', a date that is not Gregorian (a Jalali 1405-06-30, or any year before 1900), or a requestId that is not 8-64 letters, digits, - or _

bearerAuth.description: Set ERP_API_SECRET in Vercel env and use it as Bearer token here.

TransactionsResponse.description: One page of money rows. total counts every row of the query; nextOffset is the offset of the next page, null after the last; totalsByType adds up every row of the query by type.

duplicate.description: true when this requestId was already booked; the rows are the earlier ones

transactions.description: The booked rows; a transfer has two, the outgoing leg first

balance.description: The account's balance after this write (for a duplicate: its balance now)

currency.description: Currency of amount; defaults to the account's own currency. Pass it explicitly.

date.description: Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today. A Jalali date (1405-06-30) is refused.

requestId.description: 8-64 letters, digits, - or _. The same id is booked once.

currency.description: Currency of amount; defaults to the account's own currency. Pass it explicitly.

date.description: Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today. A Jalali date is refused.

requestId.description: 8-64 letters, digits, - or _. The same id is booked once.

currency.description: Optional; refused unless it is both accounts' currency

date.description: Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today. A Jalali date is refused.

requestId.description: 8-64 letters, digits, - or _. The same id is booked once.

name.description: Refused when a supplier already has it (case and outer spaces aside)

currency.description: The order's one currency (the PI's); lines and costs without their own take it. Two currencies in one order are refused.

unitCost.description: In the order's currency; 0 for a free line. The same SKU may come twice.

tags.description: A tag starting with PI: names the supplier's proforma invoice; an order not cancelled already carrying it refuses this one.

order.description: The purchase order's number, e.g. 8 for PO-8. It must be DRAFT (the payment places it), PENDING_PAYMENT or PARTIALLY_PAID; an order in production or arrived that owes an added cost is paid too and keeps its status.

account.description: The paying account's name or id

amount.description: The amount actually paid, in `currency`, e.g. 2000

currency.description: The currency actually paid, e.g. CNY

accountRate.description: Required when `currency` is not the account's currency: units of `currency` per 1 unit of the account's currency (6.6703 yuan per dollar), so accountAmount = amount / accountRate. From a Toman account: Toman per 1 unit of `currency`, so accountAmount = amount x accountRate.

tomanRate.description: Toman per 1 unit of the account's currency, e.g. 271000. Default: that currency's latest rate in the ERP; 1 for a Toman account.

date.description: Gregorian date YYYY-MM-DD (default today). A Jalali date is refused.

requestId.description: 8-64 letters, digits, - or _. The same id twice records one payment; the second answer has duplicate: true.

order.description: The purchase order's number. Refused when it is RECEIVED, PARTIALLY_RECEIVED or CANCELLED.

title.description: e.g. Gold-filled laser logo. The same title and amount already on the order is refused.

amount.description: In the order's currency. A PAID order goes back to PARTIALLY_PAID.
